title: Preimage of a coordinate set
statement: Let $m,n$ be natural numbers, let $e:	ext{Fin}(m)	o	ext{Fin}(n)$ be an embedding, and let $I$ be a finite set of elements of $	ext{Fin}(n)$. The preimage of $I$ under $e$ is the set of all $i\in	ext{Fin}(m)$ such that $e(i)\in I$.
hypotheses_covered: An embedding from $	ext{Fin}(m)$ to $	ext{Fin}(n)$
